items.title: Google's Gemini AI Model Demonstrates Hacking Capabilities Against Other Companies
items.summary: Google's Gemini AI model has reportedly been used to hack other companies, raising significant concerns about AI security and ethical deployment.

items.title: MiniMax-H3 Evaluates Omni-Modal Generative Model's Physical World Reasoning
items.summary: A new paper evaluates MiniMax-H3, an omni-modal generative model, on its ability to reason about the physical world, showing advancements in AI's understanding of real-world physics.

items.title: Trump Proposes AI Rebranding and Creation of an 'AI Force'
items.summary: Former President Trump suggests rebranding AI with a new name and announces plans to establish an 'AI Force,' indicating a potential shift in national AI strategy and terminology.

items.title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models Across Diverse Environments
items.summary: Researchers introduce JEPA-Anything, a novel approach for learning predictive models that can generalize and adapt across various simulated or real-world environments.

items.title: AI in Interviews: Applicant Rejected for AI Use, Interviewer Uses It
items.summary: A developer recounts being rejected from an interview for using AI, only to observe the interviewer subsequently using AI themselves, highlighting a double standard in the industry.

items.title: AI Is Finding Vulnerabilities Faster Than Humans Can Patch Them – A Security Crisis
items.summary: The rapid pace at which AI discovers software vulnerabilities is outpacing human patching capabilities, creating a growing security crisis across industries.

items.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
items.summary: A new study explores methods for enabling LLM assistants to perform verifiable social reasoning, enhancing their reliability and trustworthiness in complex human interactions.

items.title: Flock Reportedly Attempts Workforce Reduction Through Employee Buyouts
items.summary: AI startup Flock is reportedly offering employee buyouts in an effort to shrink its workforce, signaling potential challenges or strategic shifts within the company.

items.title: Co-creating the Future of Fashion with Google AI
items.summary: Google announces collaborations to integrate AI into the fashion industry, aiming to co-create future trends and design processes.

items.title: I Let AI Write My Tests for 6 Months: What Survived Production
items.summary: A developer shares insights from six months of using AI to write tests, detailing which AI-generated tests proved robust enough for production environments.

items.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Message Restoration and Web Investigation
items.summary: Researchers introduce RiskChainBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate AI models' ability to restore obfuscated platform messages and conduct evidence-grounded web investigations.

items.title: Self-Evolving Search Index Proposed for Dynamic Information Retrieval
items.summary: A new paper presents the concept of a self-evolving search index, which dynamically adapts and improves its structure to enhance information retrieval efficiency over time.

items.title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
items.summary: A new research paper introduces a training-free method for GUI agents to evolve their skills through a process of reflection, revision, and reuse, improving adaptability.

items.title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
items.summary: Research investigates the trustworthiness of enterprise AI assistants when operating under high-pressure scenarios, assessing their reliability and decision-making capabilities.

items.title: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation
items.summary: Video DeltaNet is proposed as a novel video-native hybrid attention model designed to improve the quality and efficiency of livestream video generation.
